problem_summary: 39 citizen complaints about 'Fixing/Reparing Potholes' were recorded in Arekere between March 2019 and April 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 36% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

agency_attribution_note: 39 of 39 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier HIGH (score=0.62). Top scoring factors: complaint_volume=1.00, recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=0.36.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Arekere' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Arekere for the period 2019–2022.
